ZIZIYI Office integration

Upstream source: https://github.com/baotlake/office-website
Upstream license: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0
Imported version: main branch snapshot retrieved on 2026-10-02

This application uses the upstream browser-local editor bootstrap and x2t WebAssembly
converter. The integration replaces the upstream download-only save target with an
authenticated callback to the host application, which then writes the exported Office
document back to the selected R2 object.

The complete AGPL-3.0 license text is provided in LICENSE.txt in this directory.
